name: Manhattan Mini AM 2024
information:
This is a series competition with [Manhattan Mini PM 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ManhattanMiniPM2024). You may only register for and compete in one of the two competitions. If you have already registered (with payment) for Manhattan Mini PM 2024, your registration for this competition will be rejected.

Note: Clock will be the main event. 3x3 will **NOT** be held at this competition.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzk3ODQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--9eaa3f49b4e96a8bec841d0a72d41c1d2bfe1c94/waterorg-logo.png)
 
The proceeds of this competition will be donated to [water.org](https://www.water.org)!
